messages:
rebecca_sales: Quick thread - Prospect (Medicore EU) wants SOC2 + ISO artifacts and to run a vendor red-team during the POC. They also insist on EU data residency. Need one concise checklist + pen-test letter template to send.

ana_security: We can support but need formal intake + vendor pen-test authorization. Send them https://redwood.internal/sec-intake-eu. Required artifacts: SOC2 Type II summary or report, ISO27001 cert, control mapping doc, and the vendor contact. Host scans: non-intrusive only. Full red-team requires Dedicated/Private.

devin_se: For Dedicated sizing we need: model family, qps, avg token length, concurrency, workload mix (generate/embeddings/rerank), KV cache persistence, and staging CIDRs. Provisioning ETA is ~2 weeks after signed order + network approvals.

matt_finance: POC pricing: standard 30-day Dedicated POC = 40% of monthly reserved rate, one-off setup. EU region may add network egress considerations. I can attach a provisional quote.

ops_bot: Automated: presigned S3 upload links supported for evidence. Default expiry 7 days. See https://redwood.internal/ops/presigned-evidence.

ana_security: Pen-test vendor letter minimum fields (ask customer to provide or let vendor use this template):

```
Vendor name and contact
Target scope: explicit hostnames/IPs/services and time window
Allowed techniques: list (e.g., authenticated vuln scan; exclude DoS unless explicitly approved)
Data handling: confirmation no production secrets retained; sample/test data only
Points of contact (customer + our security lead)
Signed authorized representative (name, title, date)
Insurance/indemnity clause if available
```

ana_security: Also require 72h notice for intrusive tests, and a signed Pen-test Addendum to our TOS for Dedicated/Private. If they need BYOK/KMS, flag to Legal.

rebecca_sales: Proposed quick checklist to send: 1) Fill intake URL, 2) Upload SOC2/ISO artifacts, 3) Upload vendor pen-test letter, 4) Confirm EU region (eu-west-1 or eu-central-1) and BYOK preference, 5) Provide Dedicated sizing fields, 6) Preferred test window. I'll send this with draft quote.

matt_finance: I'll attach the 40% POC quote and optional 10% burst premium.

devin_se: I'll prepare the minimal provisioning form and CIDR fields.

rebecca_sales: Thanks team - aiming to send to customer within a couple hours so they can align their red-team schedule. :pray:
